newsitem.title: UK: Stg steady in quiet Europe as UK goes to polls.
newsitem.headline: Stg steady in quiet Europe as UK goes to polls.

text.p: 1130 GMT - Sterling steady at lower levels against the mark and dollar at midday Europe but trade sluggish ahead of outcome of UK election, holiday for most of Europe.
* Little reaction to rise in UK April PMI to 53.1 vs 52.9 forecast. Manufacturing continues to show growth.
* Irish pound soft but above Wednesday's multi-year lows, trading at 0.9160/90 stg from late Wednesday's 0.9230 stg.

* Pound at 2.8030/40 marks and $1.6230/40 compared with 2.8057/67 marks and $1.6201/11 Wednesday. Stg/yen off fresh 4-1/2 year high of 207.21 seen earlier, now at 206.19/49 against levels around 206.75 late Wednesday.
